biography: Riku, known in the golfing fraternity as the brother of Panu, has a distinct, albeit brief, history with the esteemed Hector Trophée. His sole foray into this unique pair competition marks his only participation to date, an individual appearance within the tournament's twelve-year history.

Throughout his competitive outing, Riku demonstrated a spirited approach to the game. While he did not ultimately secure the coveted Hector Trophée for his pair nor claim the individual Victor Trophy, his presence contributed to the event's rich tapestry of competitors. Following this single appearance, Riku has been widely regarded as having stepped away from competitive Hector events, signaling a departure from the tournament circuit.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 approaches, it has been confirmed that Riku will not be among the field of participants. His current hiatus from the competition underscores his status as a past contender whose brief engagement is now a part of the tournament's historical record, leaving open the question of a potential return in future editions.
